title: Nnamulondo y’Amazima
intro: Omufuzi ow’amaanyi, amanyiddwa olw’amagezi ge amangi n’entebe ye ey’obwakabaka ey’ekitalo, afuna obubaka obw’ekyama okuva mu nsibuko etamanyiddwa. Empuliziganya eno etasuubirwa esomooza enzikiriza zaabwe n’obuyinza bwabwe, n’ebateeka ku lugendo lw’obubaka olujja okugezesa amagezi gaabwe era okukkakkana nga bazuukuse okw’omwoyo okw’amaanyi. Osobola okuzuula omufuzi ono n’ebintu ebyakyusa obwakabaka bwabwe bwonna?
clues: Nze n’abantu bange twasinzanga enjuba, nga tugoberera amakubo ga bajjajjaffe.
Ekinyonyi, hoopoe, ye yali omubaka atasuubirwa eyandeetera ebbaluwa okuva eri omukulembeze ow’amaanyi.
Okugezesa amagezi g’oyo eyatuma, naweereza ebirabo eby’omuwendo, naye ne biddizibwa, anti oyo eyatuma yalina obugagga obusingako wala okuva eri Allah.
Nga sinnatuuka na mu lubiri lw’oyo eyatuma, entebe yange ey’obwakabaka ey’ekitalo yatambuzibwa eyo mu ngeri ey’ekyamagero mu kaseera katono.
Bwe nnatuukayo, nnabuuzibwa oba entebe ey’obwakabaka eyatambuzibwa yali yange, ne nziramu nti, ‘Kiringa nti y’eyo yennyini.’
Nayingira mu kisenge ekinene nga wansi we nnakikyamudde ekidiba ky’amazzi, era mu kaseera ako ak’okutya, ne neewaayo ku mabbali ga Nabbi Sulaiman eri Allah, Mukama w’ensi.

arabic: قِيلَ لَهَا ٱدْخُلِى ٱلصَّرْحَ ۖ فَلَمَّا رَأَتْهُ حَسِبَتْهُ لُجَّةًۭ وَكَشَفَتْ عَن سَاقَيْهَا ۚ قَالَ إِنَّهُۥ صَرْحٌۭ مُّمَرَّدٌۭ مِّن قَوَارِيرَ ۗ قَالَتْ رَبِّ إِنِّى ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِى وَأَسْلَمْتُ مَعَ سُلَيْمَـٰنَ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
verse: She was told, "Enter the palace." But when she saw it, she thought it was a body of water and uncovered her shins [to wade through]. He said, "Indeed, it is a palace [whose floor is] made smooth with glass." She said, "My Lord, indeed I have wronged myself, and I submit with Solomon to Allāh, Lord of the worlds." (27:44)
